note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. Two identical filing rooms; the ONE changed fact is the mark the piece receives (A: original material, blue strip; B: proposed additional material, amber strip), which changes only where the piece is laid (folder A with the original file, or the separate folder B) and therefore its route. Both rooms keep the same scale, timing and objects, the folders the same size and stroke; the divider decides nothing. No winner, score, admissibility rule, time limit, outcome or jurisdiction is drawn. Brief fields: decisions, grounds, routes, outcomes, scenarioA, scenarioB, changedFact, sharedFacts and comparisonLabels are editable.
